title: DNS & DHCP Troubleshooting
subject: Networking Services
description: 30 enterprise tickets. Solve the technical challenges to restore system health. The system will automatically validate your choices.

tickets.title: Domain join fails for DEPOT-LT17
tickets.summary: A technician reports that joining DEPOT-LT17 to the domain fails. Connectivity to the DC IP is fine, but the domain name cannot be resolved.

triage.q: What is the best first triage step?
options: Apply a random fix based on guesswork with no validation.
Assume it is a user mistake and close the ticket.
Reboot immediately without collecting any details.
Confirm scope and capture exact symptoms/error text before acting.

diagnosis.q: Which approach best supports a sound diagnosis?
options: Blame the network without checking any logs or configuration.
Skip diagnosis and go straight to changes on production systems.
Form a likely root cause and identify specific evidence to confirm or rule it out.
Rely only on user opinion rather than measurable evidence.
Make multiple changes at once so you cannot isolate what fixed it.
Declare success without testing or validation.
Disable security controls to make the problem go away.
Apply the least-risk remediation, then verify the service is restored and document results.
